system.description:
When targeted by a Strike, if you have not used your Interact Action this Combat Round, spend it to Dodge: roll 1 Skill Die. On a Wit symbol the Strike automatically fails; any other symbol has no effect.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.38
system.summary: When targeted by a Strike, if you have not used your Interact Action this Combat Round, spend it to Dodge: roll 1 Skill Die. On a Wit symbol the Strike automatically fails; any other symbol has no effect.

automation.note: Use when targeted by a Strike, only if your Interact Action is unused this Combat Round (Dodge spends it). Roll 1 Skill Die (2 with Evasive, +1 more with Lightning Reflexes while your Speed is Fast). Any Wit symbol: the Strike automatically fails. Other symbols: no effect.
